text: The Nominating Panel – Toronto Local Appeal Body must select candidates for interview to fill a vacancy on the Toronto Local Appeal Body. The Nominating Panel will conduct the interviews at its December 9, 2019 meeting and make recommendations to City Council.

The Nominating Panel - Toronto Local Appeal Body: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body: Candidate LAB2-162 Candidate LAB2-166 Candidate LAB2-180 Candidate LAB2-181 Candidate LAB3-6 Candidate LAB3-32 Candidate LAB3-47 2. Recommended that 20 minutes be allotted for each interview. 3. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (November 14, 2019) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body.
